setup: The law of total probability: \(P(E) = P(E \mid B_1)P(B_1) + P(E \mid B_2)P(B_2)\), an average of the conditional probabilities weighted by how likely each box is.

steps.say: Weight each conditional probability: box one gives \([[p1]] \cdot [[c1]] = [[term1]]\), box two \([[p2]] \cdot [[c2]] = [[term2]]\).
